old_description: In 1996, Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. became a public company trading on NASDAQ under ticker “CALM”. The Company has demonstrated a long history of impressive profitable growth and operational excellence, reaching a milestone of selling over one billion dozen eggs for the first time in 2014. about:
Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. is headquartered in Ridgeland, Mississippi. The company traces its roots to 1957 when Fred R. Adams Jr. founded an egg operation in Jackson, Mississippi. In 1996, the company went public on NASDAQ under the ticker CALM and has since pursued a disciplined acquisition strategy, integrating 26 companies since 1989 to expand its production footprint.

The company produces conventional and specialty shell eggs — including cage-free, organic, free-range, pasture-raised, and nutritionally enhanced varieties — as well as prepared egg-based foods, ready-to-eat egg products, and breakfast foods under brands such as Eggland’s Best, Land O’Lakes, Farmhouse Eggs, Crepini, and Van’s Foods. Its operations span 2 breeding facilities, 2 hatcheries, 31 feed mills, 51 shell egg production facilities, 38 pullet growing facilities, 52 processing and packaging facilities, and 5 food manufacturing facilities across multiple states. As of May 2026, the company managed approximately 50 million laying hens, recorded $2.9 billion in annual net sales, and sold 1.2 billion dozen eggs.

Cal-Maine serves retail grocery and foodservice channels nationwide, supplying both consumer-facing brands and ingredient eggs to food manufacturers. Its customer base includes major retailers, foodservice distributors, and commercial food processors.

The company states its purpose is to be the leading consumer-driven provider of nutritious, affordable, and sustainable eggs and egg-based foods that fit today’s lifestyles, with a vision to ensure healthy, affordable egg choices are accessible to every household every day. It also emphasizes commitments to sustainable operations, hunger relief, and strong corporate governance.
